summary.text: Jared Hendrix is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 10 (home city listed as Fargo), serving since 2025 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Hendrix lists an occupation of Consultant.
It lists education as Associate in Computer Arts, Thomas Nelson Community College.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Hendrix's standing committee assignments as Human Services and Transportation.
